content: tobi/qmd #764 (verified primary): rerank cache key stable across model swaps - editing models.rerank returned bit-identical scores from previous model for cached (query,chunk) pairs, no TTL; fixed by including resolved rerank model in cache key (PR #848). #776 (verified primary): qmd pull download progress bars flooded Claude Code agent transcripts wasting tokens; fixed hidden-by-default (PR #872). Both are direct upstream precedents for SIF v1.2 rerank-cache identity and non-TTY progress silence.
